tokens.name: kyb-shell
tokens.usage: Outside the game frame: the page behind the paper.

tokens.name: kyb-page
tokens.usage: The paper: the ground of every KYB screen.

tokens.name: kyb-card
tokens.usage: Cards: prompt, answer cards, seats, category cards, result rows.

tokens.name: kyb-card2
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: the timer track, an empty photo frame, an unanswered chip.

tokens.name: kyb-ink
tokens.usage: Text AND every hand-drawn outline (3px chips, timer track, avatar strokes). Ink and paper swap roles in dark.

tokens.name: kyb-ink-64
tokens.usage: Secondary text: category descriptions, sub-lines, guess lines.

tokens.name: kyb-ink-55
tokens.usage: Tertiary text.

tokens.name: kyb-ink-50
tokens.usage: Score notes under the round winner.

tokens.name: kyb-ink-40
tokens.usage: Pixel meta, placeholders, hints. 3.0:1 on paper and 4.3:1 on ink, both under 4.5:1 (kept from source): never use it for anything a player must act on.

tokens.name: kyb-line
tokens.usage: Dashed rules inside cards, empty seats, the secondary button border.

tokens.name: kyb-line-08
tokens.usage: Hairlines, and the default card outline before an accent is set.

tokens.name: kyb-chip
tokens.usage: Neutral chip fill.

tokens.name: kyb-tint-n
tokens.usage: Neutral tint.

tokens.name: kyb-noise
tokens.usage: Paper grain: a 1px dot every 7px across the ground.

tokens.name: kyb-scan
tokens.usage: Scanlines, 1px every 3px: Bahjah's cabinet DNA kept under the paper.

tokens.name: kyb-shadow
tokens.usage: The hard offset shadow (4px 4px 0) under cards and the prompt. Never blurred.

tokens.name: kyb-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (chips, plinths, final tag, CTA).

tokens.name: kyb-yellow
tokens.usage: Score and winners: the prompt card frame, score box, 1st-place plinth, crown, final tag. On paper it is 2.8:1, so use it for frames, fills and 24px+ numbers, never small text.

tokens.name: kyb-glow-y
tokens.usage: Soft glow for yellow: selected and hover states, the winner card halo.

tokens.name: kyb-tint-y
tokens.usage: Wash of yellow: category card fill, floor glow.

tokens.name: kyb-green
tokens.usage: Confirm and correct: the main CTA, timer fill, correct match marks, score deltas, 3rd place, the Break the Ice category. On paper it is 3.2:1, so keep it to 18px+ bold or fills.

tokens.name: kyb-glow-g
tokens.usage: Soft glow for green: selected and hover states, the winner card halo.

tokens.name: kyb-tint-g
tokens.usage: Wash of green: category card fill, floor glow.

tokens.name: kyb-pink
tokens.usage: THE signature colour: reveal and game over, the answer field, a wrong match, the timer running out, 2nd place, the For Close Ones Only category. 4.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: kyb-glow-p
tokens.usage: Soft glow for pink: selected and hover states, the winner card halo.

tokens.name: kyb-tint-p
tokens.usage: Wash of pink: category card fill, floor glow.

tokens.name: kyb-cyan
tokens.usage: Joining: room code tiles, the round badge, links, share hover. On paper it is 3.9:1, so pair small text with the badge's 2px border.

tokens.name: kyb-glow-c
tokens.usage: Soft glow for cyan: selected and hover states, the winner card halo.

tokens.name: kyb-tint-c
tokens.usage: Wash of cyan: category card fill, floor glow.

tokens.name: kyb-purple
tokens.usage: Steps and progress: phase status, the floor glow, EPIC rarity. 7.5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: kyb-glow-pu
tokens.usage: Soft glow for purple: selected and hover states, the winner card halo.

tokens.name: kyb-tint-pu
tokens.usage: Wash of purple: category card fill, floor glow.

families.arabic: "Childos Arabic", "Noto Kufi Arabic", "Readex Pro", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: final-title
styles.usage: Game-over question, clamp(32px,4.8vw,62px). Arabic: مين عارفكم؟

styles.name: winner-name
styles.usage: Round winner's name on the winner card, clamp(30px,5vw,62px).

styles.name: final-name
styles.usage: Game winner's name under the crown, in the winner's accent.

styles.name: prompt
styles.sample: What would you do if it started raining meat?
styles.usage: The question on the TV prompt card, clamp(26px,3.6vw,44px). Weight 400: the face does the work.

styles.name: stage-title
styles.usage: Screen titles and the reveal verdict, clamp(24-26px,3.2-3.4vw,44px).

styles.name: category-name
styles.usage: Category card title, clamp(26px,3vw,38px).

styles.name: round-title
styles.usage: Round-winner heading.

styles.name: score-value
styles.usage: Score box number, in kyb-yellow. Digits fall to Space Grotesk on purpose (the demo face has none).

styles.name: code-tile
styles.usage: One letter per room code tile, uppercase, kyb-cyan.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Author name on a revealed TV answer card.

styles.name: card-text
styles.usage: Answer text on a TV answer card.

styles.name: cta
styles.usage: Button labels, uppercase.

styles.name: answer-input
styles.usage: What a player types into the answer field.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hypotheticals and what-ifs. Reveals more than you think.
styles.usage: Descriptions, result rows.

styles.name: sample
styles.usage: Sample question under a dashed rule on a category card, in the category accent.

styles.name: quip
styles.sample: Speak now if you want a different one.
styles.usage: Hints, quips, move-on links.

styles.name: guess
styles.usage: Who-guessed-whom lines under an answer.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: Round badge, status pill, card tags on TV. Uppercase.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Kicker on the winner card and category tags.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, timer label, score box label, the end-room button.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Small category tags.

styles.name: rarity
styles.usage: Character rarity on the avatar picker.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Display in Arabic: Childos leads, with Noto Kufi Arabic for numerals. Silkscreen has no Arabic, so pixel labels swap to Readex Pro.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.sample: افتراضات و«ماذا لو». تكشف أكثر مما تظن.
styles.usage: Running text in Arabic.
